label: Bible Study
prompt: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the _____.
verse: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
note: Peter's tired reply after a fruitless night — the catch that followed nearly sank two boats.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the _____:
verse: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
note: John falls at His feet like a dead man, and Jesus lays a right hand on him: Fear not.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD opened the _____ of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verse: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
note: The Bible's only talking donkey — and her first words are a complaint about being hit three times.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face _____ while he talked with him.
verse: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
note: Moses came down glowing from Sinai and was the last to know — he later wore a veil when he spoke to the people.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For consider him that endured such _____ of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verse: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
note: When you're weary, consider Jesus, who 'endured such contradiction of sinners' — hostility — against himself.
